label: The 002 parent goal has 7 characters spare and no rows for 037, 038 or 039; 037 has no goal.md, a grouped row fails check-goal, and the smallest honest fix is two standard rows plus D1/D7 and criterion-1/4 cuts, leaving 037 as a recorded exception.

Phase 033 says Draft in its spec and phase map while all nine child specs say Complete and no child acceptance file has an Unmet row; the right status is Complete once the parent spec, phase map, continuity fields and parent goal criteria are reconciled. The recursive validation command was not run.

sk-git SKILL.md's claim that a rebase keeps a Commit-Id is incomplete: prepare-commit-msg keeps an id only when the replayed message still carries the trailer, mints a fresh id when the message lacks it, and always re-mints a cherry-pick; the copy clause belongs to the collision check.
The 002 binding table lacks rows for 037, 038 and 039; 037 has no goal.md and the 7-character margin cannot hold three standard rows without cuts.
The 033 parent spec and phase map say Draft while all nine child specs are Complete and their acceptance files have no Unmet rows.

The 039 reworded-commit log and the current commit trailers show the first id kept and the second and third re-minted, matching the prepare-commit-msg message-content rule rather than an unconditional rebase rule.
A binding row covers a phase only when its second table cell is exactly that phase's child/goal.md path.
prepare-commit-msg preserves a Commit-Id only when the pending message already contains one and CHERRY_PICK_HEAD is absent; otherwise it mints max+1.
